ios.desc:
Pomo Up is a Pomodoro timer with a buddy who focuses right alongside you. Pick a tag, tap start, and block the apps that pull you away.

NEW IN 7.0
- An all-new design, built for Liquid Glass
- Made for iPhone Duo, on both the cover and inner screens
- Tag presets: each tag remembers its own duration and timer mode
- New widgets: Today, This Week, and Quick Start

FOCUS YOUR WAY
- Pomodoro or stopwatch: count down, or count up with no time limit
- Tag presets: start Study, Work, or Reading in one tap
- Picture in Picture: keep the timer in view while you use other apps
- Live Activities: start your next session from the Lock Screen or Dynamic Island
- Spotlight & Siri: search a tag to start, or ask Siri how long you focused today

STAY ON TRACK
- App Blocker: block chosen apps while you focus; pause anytime you need a break
- Pomo Buddies: wear AirPods and your buddy moves with you. Meet the Dog, Duck, Dino, Giraffe, and Capybara
- Widgets: start a session or check today's progress right from your Home Screen

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
- Today's report, weekly insights, and full statistics
- See where your time goes by tag
- Leaderboard: see how your focus stacks up with the community

EVERYWHERE YOU WORK
iPhone, iPad, iPhone Duo, and Mac, kept in sync with iCloud.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account needed. Your focus records stay on your device and sync through your own iCloud.

COMMUNITY FEEDBACK

"Pomo Up helps me stay on task without distractions. It's been a game-changer for my focus." – Ben
"I’ve been getting more done in less time. Love the animations and how simple it is to use!" – Alice
"I used to get sidetracked all the time, but Pomo Up keeps me aware and consistent." – Sam

POMO UP PRO
Block distracting apps, unlock all Pomo Buddies, full charts, Home Screen widgets, unlimited tags, stopwatch mode, and the Mac app.
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings
- Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription
